description: Transaction receipt on Sonic (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in S, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use sonic_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xcc6a5594962b5211496391d0e1e9082f5060f218fad60f907a23e85a7b02bf85. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: sonic_receipt
title: Sonic transaction receipt
